review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Security Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Purpose The On-Premises Security Engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise data center infrastructure, with specialized ownership of security engineering for VMware vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi hosts, virtual machines, and the supporting identity, network, storage, backup, logging, and management services. The role establishes and maintains secure configurations, monitors for threats and control failures, drives vulnerability remediation, supports incident response, and provides se
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Working closely with On-Premises Operations, Security Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, Network, Storage, Backup, R&D, QA, Compliance, and corporate IT teams, the engineer converts security requirements into practical, supportable controls that protect availability, integrity, confidentiality, and recoverability without introducing unnecessary operational risk. Assess VMware architecture and configuration changes for security impact; document requirements, risks, exceptions, compensating controls, validation steps, and rollback considerations. Track remediation through closure, validate corrective actions, and document accepted risks or approved exceptions in accordance with governance requirements. Data Center Consolidation & Migration Security Provide security engineering and assurance throughout data-center consolidation and workload migration activities, including pre-migration
